rules.name: APAAR Identifier Format & Privacy Guard
rules.description: Raw APAAR input must be a 12-digit numeric string not starting with 0 or 1. Rejects Aadhaar-labeled columns and masks display to ****-****-XXXX.

rules.name: AICTE Sanctioned Program Code
rules.description: Program code must match an active AICTE-approved discipline registered for the institution academic year.

rules.name: Academic Age Eligibility Window
rules.description: Candidate age at enrollment year must be within the deterministic range [16, 35] years.

rules.name: Student Data & Attestation Consent
rules.description: Verifies whether explicit student consent is recorded before platform-issued attestation eligibility.

rules.name: Cross-Institution Duplicate APAAR Hash
rules.description: Detects identical irreversible APAAR hash across two institutions or active batches and opens a human review conflict case.

rules.name: AICTE Approved Intake Threshold
rules.description: Checks whether cumulative verified enrolment for the program stays within AICTE approved intake capacity.
